rationale: The permit Part I clause states that the facility uses ultraviolet disinfection and that Total Residual Chlorine (TRC) shall be monitored any time chlorine is used within the treatment plant. This directly establishes that TRC monitoring for NM0020583 is conditional on chlorine use, not required as routine UV-plant effluent monitoring. The cover-page effective dates (2021-12-01 through 2026-11-30) encompass Federal FY2025, and the purpose A period span confirms the temporal scope. The packet's known missing chlorine-use logs for FY2025 months bear on whether monitoring was required in any specific month, but they do not undermine the established conditional structure of the requirement; per the relation contract, month-level required/not-required status may remain UNRESOLVED without contradicting acceptance that conditional monitoring applies.
